answer: Duplicating identities then requires acquiring real pearls and timber, making mass sybil creation economically prohibitive while legitimate participants amortize costs over genuine production. Sybil resistance can be anchored in proof-of-work tied to scarce physical resources: each agent must submit a verified provenance record for a unique pearl harvested from a registered fishery, plus a timber license from a managed forest, before it can forge a new reputation slot in the economy. In practice, sa0011 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
